# resolve/name

> Rename rule: one name a package or truck defines.

truck [resolve](../resolve.md) · [source](../../../registry/resolve/name.pkg)

```
resolve
  rename name 'list_all' in filesystem/io to 'list_files'
end
```

Like [prefix](prefix.md), for a single name: functions, globals,
constants and structs. It is an error if the scope doesn't define it.
